svg.title: ObservedState.dev deploy pipeline
svg.desc: A pull request builds the site, a merge to main builds again, then the deploy job exchanges a GitHub OIDC token for the observedstate-site-deploy role, syncs the bucket and invalidates CloudFront.
svg.text: GitHub Actions to AWS with OIDC: no long-lived AWS keys anywhere in GitHub
A Pull request (build only, nothing deploys)
Ruleset on main (free plan, public repo)
Required status check: build must pass
No force-push, no branch deletion, no bypass actors
B Merge to main (build, then deploy)
What stops anyone else from deploying
Trust policy accepts only this repo, by GitHub ID, on refs/heads/main
Pull requests, forks and other branches cannot assume the role
Role is limited to s3:ListBucket, Put/DeleteObject on this bucket
and cloudfront:CreateInvalidation . The boundary caps it further
Set with gh variable set at repo level, not on an environment
